frost__root.description: Unlocks Icicle (Level 3) (11 mana, 2.99 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__root.extra_description: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches. The first skill of the Frost base.

frost__planned_snow_sentinels.extra_description: Summon snow golems whose snowballs slow and chill enemies.

frost__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
frost__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

frost__blizzard.description: Unlocks Blizzard (Level 3) (45 mana, 32.92 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__blizzard.extra_description: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.

frost__frost_step.title: Frost Step
frost__frost_step.description: Unlocks Frost Step (Level 3) (19 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__frost_step.extra_description: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

frost__snowball.title: Snowball
frost__snowball.description: Unlocks Snowball (Level 3) (33 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__snowball.extra_description: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

frost__mana_shield.title: Mana Shield
frost__mana_shield.description: Teaches Mana Shield, an Epic Fight Guard skill: Damage taken is paid for with mana, in proportion to the hit against your max health. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

frost__ice_chamber.title: Ice Chamber
frost__ice_chamber.description: Unlocks Ice Chamber (Level 3) (42 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__ice_chamber.extra_description: Shoot a freezing ray that will freeze an area around the impact and sometimes even the enemy itself.

frost__frostwave.title: Frostwave
frost__frostwave.description: Unlocks Frostwave (Level 3) (45 mana, 67.33 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__frostwave.extra_description: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

frost__against_magic.title: Magic Immunity
frost__against_magic.description: Teaches Magic Immunity, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Grants extremely high magic resistance. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

frost__ice_spikes.title: Ice Spikes
frost__ice_spikes.description: Unlocks Ice Spikes (Level 3) (38 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__ice_spikes.extra_description: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.

frost__cone_of_cold.title: Cone of Cold
frost__cone_of_cold.description: Unlocks Cone of Cold (Level 3) (5 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__cone_of_cold.extra_description: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.

frost__charge_ray_of_frost.title: Frost Blast
frost__charge_ray_of_frost.description: Unlocks Frost Blast (Level 3) (35 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__charge_ray_of_frost.extra_description: fire a ray of frost at the target. The impacted area explodes, dealing secondary damage.

frost__ice_block.title: Ice Block
frost__ice_block.description: Unlocks Ice Block (Level 3) (45 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__ice_block.extra_description: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.

frost__frostbite.title: Frostbite
frost__frostbite.description: Unlocks Frostbite (Level 3) (76 mana, 89.78 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__frostbite.extra_description: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

frost__blizzard_2.title: Hail
frost__blizzard_2.description: Unlocks Hail (Level 3) (16 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__blizzard_2.extra_description: Target a single area summon a blizzard from above for the duration of the spell

frost__glintstone_icecrag.title: Glintstone Icecrag
frost__glintstone_icecrag.description: Unlocks Glintstone Icecrag (Level 3) (20 mana, 4.49 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__glintstone_icecrag.extra_description: Fires a homing shard of ice that bursts on impact, damaging and freezing enemies around it.

frost__hypervitality.title: Hyper Vitality
frost__hypervitality.description: Teaches Hyper Vitality, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Innate skills use stamina when your weapon charge is not full. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

frost__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
frost__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

frost__ice_age.title: Ice Age
frost__ice_age.description: Unlocks Ice Age (Level 3) (5 mana, 29.93 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
frost__ice_age.extra_description: Freeze everything around you, covering the world in ice.

frost__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
frost__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen
